neighbours.label: the token 'Bet' / 'bet' (the verb bet and names split as Bet+…: Betsey, Bethea, Betts)
fire: On Friday my aunt Betsey drove us to the county fair.
The quarterback found Bethea open in the end zone twice.
I would bet that the store closes early on holidays.
The card was signed by Mr. Betts and the rest of the office staff.
Last summer we interviewed Senator Betancourt about the treaty.
He lost a small bet on the horse race at Ascot.
Thanks to the rain, you can bet the match will be cancelled.
The children asked whether Betsey could stay for dinner.
quiet: On Friday my aunt Margaret drove us to the county fair.
The quarterback found Johnson open in the end zone twice.
I would guess that the store closes early on holidays.
The card was signed by Mr. Harris and the rest of the office staff.
Last summer we interviewed Senator Hernandez about the treaty.
He lost a small wager on the horse race at Ascot.
Thanks to the rain, you can expect the match will be cancelled.
The children asked whether Margaret could stay for dinner.

notes: Card: ' Bet' x19, ' bet' x6, BET. Tokenizer checked: Betsey/Bethea/Betts/Betancourt split as ' Bet'+...; Betty and Bethlehem are single tokens, so avoided.
